note: An evidence bundle may contain only the artifact classes admitted here. Anything else fails closed. Deny rules are not a substitute for this list; they are a second, independent check applied to the admitted bytes.

admitted.why: The semantic projection of the exercise. This is the result.
Per-case stances derived from each party's own declared stance map.
The terminal outcome, drawn from the policy's permitted set.
Which claims the evidence supports, underdetermines, or prohibits.
Phase and ledger-shape status. Carries no ledger bodies.
The infrastructure-unavailable record. Present only when the run could not execute; it carries no semantic conclusion.
The frozen case set the exercise ran over. Authored by the lab, public already.
The experiment policy, already public in this repository.
The WEXP party's own native results, as the WEXP party stated them.
The counterparty's own native results, as the counterparty stated them.
Which public commit of the counterparty produced those results.
Which public commit of the WEXP party produced those results.
How to obtain the same evidence without this workflow.
The manifest itself. Written by the gate, excluded from its own entries.

denied_classes: private tooling commit or ref identity

not_yet_admitted.why: Commitment digests are publishable in principle; nothing in X-001 requires them, so they stay out.

not_yet_admitted.artifact_class: revealed blind case after authorized reveal
not_yet_admitted.why: X-001 has no blind case. A future experiment must admit the specific path after its reveal is authorized, never by a wildcard.
No ablation is part of X-001.

non_claims: Admission to this list is a publication decision, not a security proof.
A file admitted here is still subject to every deny rule the gate applies.

declared_object_ids.where: experiments/X-001/cases.json, and the frozen case set derived from it
declared_object_ids.why: A synthetic placeholder in the shared-subject fixture. It names no repository and identifies no object; the case set is already public in this repository.
